app: Terre & Tour, made by an agent without AEOM

defects.what: Cream paper, a big serif headline and a terracotta accent: the exact look the principle names.
At 390 px the filter form fills the first screen: the classes, what the page is for, start below it.
At 390 px the menu wraps, « Mes réservations » alone on a second line.
In the week's list nothing says a class opens to be booked: no button, the title is the only link and does not look like one.
